Cross-check: for each S8 column, S8(mark)/S8(unmodified) equals (LightR/HeavyR)_mark / (LightR/HeavyR)_unmod from histone_ratios_SILAC.xls for the file with that suffix: H3K9me2 33/33 MCF7 and 7/7 T47D exact (<1%), H3K4me1 33/33 and 7/7 exact; a one-position shifted map gives 0-3 exact. claims.value: SILAC light (sample) / SILAC heavy (super-SILAC internal standard)
claims.evidence: Methods "Histone PTMs Mass Spectrometry Analysis": "~4 ug of histone octamer were mixed with an equal amount of heavy-isotope labeled histones, which were used as an internal standard (super-SILAC mix)... the sample (light channel: L) or the internal standard (heavy channel: H)". EpiProfile output histone_ratios_SILAC.xls has LightR/HeavyR per peptide for every file; histone_logs.txt "histone with SILAC" (rule 14 multiplexing verified).

claims.location: characteristics[sample type], characteristics[pooled sample], characteristics[biological replicate], characteristics[cell line], factor value[cell line], characteristics[age], characteristics[sex], source name heavy rows (even rows 2,4,...,86)
claims.value: reference / pooled / pooled / super-SILAC mix / super-SILAC mix / pooled / pooled / "super-SILAC heavy histone internal standard, aliquot spiked into sample n"
claims.evidence: Paper: heavy channel = internal standard "super-SILAC mix; ref. 60" (a super-SILAC mix is by definition a mix of labelled cell lines). Neither the paper nor ref 60 (Cuomo 2011, pairwise SILAC of MCF7, MDA-MB231, MDA-MB453, T-47D vs normal) names the components of the mix used here, so no component cell line is asserted (rule 8/18). The cell-lines template forbids not available/not applicable for cell line and TERMS.tsv sets its allow_pooled=false (not enforced by parse_sdrf/structure), so the free text "super-SILAC mix" (curated PXD002098) is used, and factor value[cell line] mirrors it (review round 2). The heavy rows are identified as the spiked-in reference, not study samples, by characteristics[sample type] = reference and characteristics[pooled sample] = pooled (also biological replicate = pooled); treatment, adaptation phase and sampling time factors are not applicable. age and sex = pooled: the human template allows pooled for both (review F4). One source per aliquot so (source, replicate, fraction) stays unique.

PRIDE organisms: Homo sapiens. MCF-7 and T-47D: NCBI_TaxID=9606. Heavy rows: the mix is a human super-SILAC standard (ref 60 human breast cancer lines; deposit is human-only); species of the mix components is not explicitly stated (see limitations).

claims.value: MCF-7 / CVCL_0031 / MCF-7 ; T-47D cell / CVCL_0553 / T-47D
claims.evidence: Paper Methods: "Breast cancer cell lines MCF7 and T47D were kindly provided by Philippa Darbre"; T47D described as "p53-mutant L194F T47D" = Cellosaurus T-47D TP53 p.Leu194Phe (homozygous). Table S8 sheets "MCF7" (samples 1-33) and "T47D" (34-43). OLS: EFO:0001203 label "MCF-7"; EFO:0001247/BTO:0001248 label "T-47D cell". Cell line is a compared variable (factor value[cell line]): Table S8 has separate MCF7 and T47D sheets and Fig. 6A shows separate MCF7 and T47D heat maps, so MCF7 and T47D samples of the same treatment/phase/time are distinct conditions (review round 2, R2-F1).

claims.evidence: Cellosaurus CVCL_0031 / CVCL_0553: DI NCIt C4194 "Invasive breast carcinoma of no special type" (MONDO:0004953 invasive ductal breast carcinoma is MONDO:equivalentTo NCIT:C4194); Derived from site: Metastatic; Pleural effusion (UBERON:0000175); breast carcinoma -> organism part breast (UBERON:0000310); SX Female; AG 69Y / 54Y (>=20Y -> adult EFO:0001272, rule 9); Population Caucasian -> HANCESTRO:0005 European ancestry.
All samples are cultured MCF7/T47D cells; the heavy standard is histones from SILAC-labelled cultured cells (super-SILAC).
Methods: cells cultured in DMEM + 10% FCS + E2; -E2 arm kept in phenol red-free DMEM (Gibco 11880028) + 10% charcoal-stripped FCS. NCIT:C185409.

claims.location: characteristics[adaptation phase], factor value[adaptation phase], characteristics[sampling time], factor value[sampling time] light rows (odd rows 1,3,...,85)
claims.value: pretreatment (POT, 0 day) / latency (7 day, 14 day) / dormancy (30 day) / late dormancy (60 day) / awakening (not available) / late progression (TEP, not available)
claims.evidence: Table S8 group headers: "Time zero" (POT.1/2; Fig. 6A "time zero (T0)") -> sampling time 0 day since treatment onset. POT is the pretreatment baseline population, not the separate untreated (UT) arm of the paper, cultured in parallel for 170-180 days, which is not in this deposit. "Latency (transition to dormancy)" (7 and 14 days), "Dormancy" (30), "Late dormancy" (60), "Awakening (relapse)" (alpha... ). Methods: shared harvest time points day 7, day 14, 1 month, 2 months; awakening = harvest at resumption of proliferation (diverging per carbon copy, day not stated in text); TEP = awakened carbon copy further cultured 1 month with passaging = "late progression". Custom characteristics column (spec Extending Templates; rule 15).

claims.location: comment[sdrf version], comment[sdrf template], comment[sdrf annotation tool] rows 1-86
claims.value: v1.1.0; ms-proteomics v1.2.0, human v1.1.0, cell-lines v1.1.0; NT=sdrf-skills;VV=v0.1.0
claims.evidence: Rule 1 and 10; templates filled by sdrf-tools build from the contract (contract.txt header). The spec submodule nested templates.yaml still says ms-proteomics latest 1.1.0 (older copy).

One injection per sample deposited; the HF221020 re-runs of 11,13,14,16,17,18,38,43 replace the HF220914 originals, which are not deposited as RAW (only their EpiProfile intermediates are in Magnani.zip) and S8 uses the re-runs ("bis").

limitations: Heavy channel composition: the super-SILAC histone mix components are not named in the paper, ref 60 or the deposit; heavy rows carry cell line "super-SILAC mix" (free text; sdrf-tools check flags it), age and sex = pooled, and cellosaurus accession/name, disease, ancestry, organism part, developmental stage = not available; organism Homo sapiens is inferred (human super-SILAC standard, human-only deposit) rather than stated.

Precursor/fragment mass tolerance = not available: EpiProfile 2.0 is a targeted XIC tool, not a database search, and no tolerance is recorded in the deposit or paper. parse_sdrf convert-openms therefore fails on this file (kept per references/validation.md).

Modification parameters describe the EpiProfile pr_pic quantification scheme (no search-engine parameter file exists); Propionyl on monomethyl-K (methyl+propionyl) is represented by the separate Methyl and Propionyl entries.
Sampling time for awakening and TEP samples is not available: harvest days differ per carbon copy and are only plotted (Fig. 2A), not stated.

Samples 38 (T47D AI A), 39 (T47D AI B) and 43 (T47D AI F TEP) are deposited and quantified by EpiProfile but absent from Table S8 (likely excluded at the 50%-quantified filter); annotated from Sample_legend only.

POT samples (treatment untreated, phase pretreatment, sampling time 0 day) are the pretreatment baseline that Table S8 labels "Time zero". They are NOT the paper's separate untreated (UT) arm (serially passaged in parallel for 170-180 days), which was not measured by MS in this deposit. The Methods also use T0 for samples collected 48 h after seeding; the Sample_legend name POT was followed.
techsdrf is not installed; instrument/method values come from HTTP-range-read raw headers of 6 of 43 files (all consistent) and the EpiProfile .ms2 header.
Treatment "estrogen deprivation" has no NCIT/EFO term (validator warning); "untreated" (rule 4) also warns.

External review: round 1 FAIL (F1) led to removing factor value[cell line]; round 2 FAIL (R2-F1) showed that this merged MCF-7 and T-47D into shared conditions. Decision (round 4): cell line is a compared variable (Table S8 separate sheets, Fig. 6A separate heat maps), so factor value[cell line] is restored with heavy rows mirroring super-SILAC mix, and the reference is identified by sample type = reference / pooled sample = pooled. Replicates restart per (cell line, treatment, phase, time). Re-review pending (REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL); no self-review.
